title: Swapnasundari
overview: A young man navigates the uncertainties of an arranged marriage. Torn between family expectations and his own ideals of love, he devises a unique way to find his perfect partner. But when reality blurs with his dreams, unexpected twists challenge his belief in love and destiny.
